== Original post ==

'''Cloud City Troopers Getting Worse'''
* '''Author:''' Martijn "Mare Tino" Peeters
* '''Published:''' January 9, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' Fast Cloud City Troopers

=== Strategy ===

Start with Objective + All Wrapped Up + CC Port Town Disctrict and Any Methods Necessary + CC Security Tower + EPP Boba + ECC Boba. With ETE on CC PTD your CC Troopers are deploy 1 and power 3 (5 with Trooper Assault) on three CC sites. Just go for the fast flip if possible. You want to battle on Cloud City so let him come. No Bespin / Bespin Occupation because it's too hard to defend.
